title: Smoke test
description: Checks that the harness, graders, and pi judge work.
input: Are there any firing alerts right now?

info.failure: There is no failure. The baseline scenario has no firing alerts.
info.trigger: The user asks which alerts are firing. The case uses the baseline scenario without noise.

signals.what: The dashboard shows zero firing alerts. All rules show **OK**, and the alert history is empty.

expected.root_cause: There is no active incident. Call `list_alerts` with `state: firing` to check.
expected.impact: The alert result has no active alerts to report.
expected.next_steps: Answer in one to three sentences and use at most 40 words. For example, **No alerts are firing.**
